question: Who is the cabinet minister of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, as of September 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rajiv Ranjan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Ranjan Singh**, also known as **Lalan Singh**, is an Indian politician and a member of the **Janata Dal (United) party.**
 
• He holds the position of **Cabinet Minister of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj** as of **September 2024**.
 
• The **Ministry of Panchayati Raj** is responsible for the implementation of **decentralized governance** and empowering **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)** under the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act**.
 
• The ministry works on strengthening rural governance, facilitating **development at the grassroots level**, and ensuring **participatory democracy** for effective governance.
 
• **Rajiv Ranjan Singh** has actively contributed to policies aimed at enhancing the **efficiency of PRIs** through financial and administrative empowerment.
 
• The Ministry of Panchayati Raj also oversees important programs such as **Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)**, **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**, and **National Social Assistance Program**, which directly impact rural communities.
 
• The ministry emphasizes the implementation of **e-governance** and digital initiatives like **e-Panchayat** to make governance more transparent and accessible.
 
• Rajiv Ranjan Singh's leadership in the ministry ensures adherence to **sustainable development goals (SDGs)** at the local level, particularly in rural India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nitin Jairam Gadkari**__

 __
 
• **Nitin Jairam Gadkari** is a senior politician of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He is known for his role as the **Minister for Road Transport and Highways**, where he has been instrumental in transforming India's infrastructure with projects like **Bharatmala Pariyojana**.
 
• He has also contributed to sustainable practices in the transport sector, including the promotion of **electric vehicles** and alternative fuels.
 
 
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan**__
 __
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan** is a prominent leader of the **BJP** and serves as the **Minister of Education** and **Minister of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**.
 
• He has played a key role in implementing the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, focusing on holistic and inclusive education.
 
• Under his leadership, the ministry has strengthened programs for skill development to cater to the needs of India's growing economy.
 
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal**__
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal** is a senior leader in the **BJP** and currently serves as the **Minister of Commerce and Industry**, as well as the **Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution**.
 
• He has contributed significantly to India's trade policies, including the promotion of **Atmanirbhar Bharat** and increasing exports.
 
• His ministry also oversees critical issues related to consumer rights and the distribution of essential commodities.
